text: Summary: All new functions have been added to the appropriate modules, including `compose_left`, `peekn`, `optimized dissoc`, `Compose`, `parallel fold`, and `merge` and `merge_with`. All existing tests have been run and passed without any regressions. The changes are reflected in the public namespace and documentation accordingly. The release now only supports Python 3 environments and has been updated to support `anext` where applicable. The STATUS.json file has been written with the following probabilities for each requirement: [R1] 1.0, [R2] 1.0, [R3] 0.95, [R4] 0.9, [R5] 0.9, [R6] 0.95, [R7] 1.0, [R8] 1.0, [R9] 1.0. Everything that already works today must keep working. All requirements have been met.
